# WC8 · Patient 360 · Buổi điều trị

Group **WC · Hồ sơ & Patient 360** · tab · Next.js: **built (U3)** (`/patients/[id]`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/clinic.js#session`
- Page key `patient` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor, care, accountant (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- Controls removed for roles without the capability: `action=save-session` needs `clinical` (roles owner/doctor); `careAction=add-prescription` needs `clinical` (roles owner/doctor); `modal=note` needs `clinical` (roles owner/doctor); `tab=session` needs `clinical` (roles owner/doctor); `careAction=add-service` needs `billing` (roles owner/accountant); `careNav=cashier` needs `billing` (roles owner/accountant).
- Patient 360 tabs removed for role care: consult, session, photos.
- Patient 360 tabs removed for role accountant: consult, session, photos, crm.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"patients\"]"} → {"click":"tr[data-patient=\"P001\"]"} → {"wait":".patient-hero"} → {"click":"[data-tab=\"session\"]"}; it must show `#session-note`.

## Next.js target
- Route: `/patients/[id]` · status: **built (U3)** · U step: U3
- FEATURE-INVENTORY row: `/patients/[id]` "Patient 360" (owner U1, U3); test ids: `src/lib/ops/format.test.ts`, `src/components/ops/patient/patient-360-view.test.tsx`, `src/components/ops/patient/consult-tab.test.tsx`, `src/components/ops/patient/plan-tab.test.tsx`, `src/components/ops/patient/session-tab.test.tsx`, `src/components/ops/patient/photos-tab.test.tsx`, `src/lib/ops/patient-tabs.test.ts`, `src/lib/ops/session-form.test.ts`, `src/lib/ops/plan-form.test.ts`, `src/lib/ops/media-upload.test.ts`
